summary:
ToothPaste is a React PWA with no backend. It sends keystrokes and pastes text to a Bluetooth dongle (stubbed here). I saved 5 views, and each one replayed with a 1.00 match:
1) duckyscript-manager: the Paste → Duckyscript tab, which lists the saved scripts with their line count, valid/error status and estimated time, plus the New Script and Import buttons.
2) script-editor: the Edit Script screen with the imported Hak5 reverse-shell script open. Its status bar shows "3 errors", and it has the Update, Delete, Export and Back buttons and an Execute Script panel.
3) live-capture: the Live Capture workspace after clicking Connect to Device, which connected to the stubbed "ToothPaste Desk" dongle. The media-control sidebar is on the left and the Shortcuts panel is open. The ⋮ button that opens this panel is clicked by x/y coordinates with the page at the top, because the role/name and CSS attempts both failed.
4) firmware-update: the Update dialog for flashing firmware, with a board selector and a Connect button.
5) quick-start: step 1 of the 5-step Quick Start onboarding dialog.
I left out three screens: the Paste → Text tab, which is just an empty text box and button; the About page, which is documentation-style; and the Live Capture screen before connecting, which is almost the same as the connected one.
